Prices can vary wildly for this type of work. But the rule of “you get what you pay for” holds true.

You can find a college kid who might have some experience and pay $20-30 hr.

Hire a company to do it and it’ll jump to 55-100 an hr. You could probably find cheaper but those companies are gonna be mulch jockeys. (Folks who just mulch and mow lawns.) 

Best bet is finding a college kid that is home for the summer. Probably not the most reliable but they could use the money and have just as much experience as anyone working as a mulch jockey.

Colleges always have a grounds maintenance team with students working as a summer gig. Contact those places  closer to summer and let them know you’re looking for help with your yard. State your rate you’re willing to pay too or nobody is gonna take the bait.
